scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.src.json && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.lsp.json && bunx tsc -p editors/vscode/tsconfig.json
scripts.build:vscode: bun build src/lsp.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=editors/vscode/dist/lsp.mjs && bun build editors/vscode/src/extension.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external vscode --outfile=editors/vscode/dist/extension.js
scripts.build: bun run build:lsp && bun run build:vscode
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
